title: Are we missing clear intentions? Problem, claim and remedy with domains and personas give the intent autonomy needs (2026-10-28)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: Are we generally missing clear intentions for our work? The problem and claim and remedy process - with domains and personas is an attempt to provide rich intent. By understanding these, we should have a clear goal for autonomy that does not require relentless ownership decisions and merge
